Bill.BriefDescription: Providing immunity for nonprofit and charitable corporations that provide used eyeglasses for charitable purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liability of nonprofit and charitablecorporations; amending RCW 43.20A.800; and adding a new section tochapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.20A.800 and 1993 c 96 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of the department of social and health services shallcoordinate the efforts of nonprofit agencies working with the homeless,poor, and uninsured, the Washington academy of eye physicians andsurgeons, the Washington optometric association, and the opticiansassociation of Washington to deliver vision services to the homeless,poor, and uninsured free of charge. The secretary shall enter intoagreements identifying cooperating agencies and the circumstances underwhich specified services will be delivered.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A nonprofit corporation and any other charitable corporation is p. 1 SB 6216not liable for any damages arising out of providing previously ownedeyeglasses to a person if: (a) The person is at least fourteen years of age; and (b) The eyeglasses are provided to the person without charge. (2) The immunity provided by subsection (1) of this section appliesto eyeglasses only if: (a) The eyeglasses are provided by a licensed optometrist orophthalmologist who has personally examined the person who will receivethe eyeglasses; or (b) The eyeglasses are provided by a licensed optician who hasconsulted with the licensed optometrist or ophthalmologist whopersonally examined the person who will receive the eyeglasses.
